note: Each chapter opens with one epigraph verse (block 0). The English quotes the ESV (WEB for Psalm 68:31); the version label is dropped, as in the other translated teens editions, because the Spanish follows the shipped es corpus's modern Reina-Valera register instead. The ebible spa_rv (archaic RV1909) was not used.

`mined` rows are a verbatim substring of the cited file's rendering of that verse. Where the English quotes only part of a verse, the Spanish quotes the same part of the corpus wording (Hechos 2:17 stops at «profetizarán», as the English stops at 'shall prophesy').

`self_rendered` rows are written in RVR1960 register from the translator's knowledge of that text, not pasted from a source: please check them. 1 Corintios 14:34 is Amanda's critics' quotation in chapter 11 (uncited in the English); her own retort «Vuestros hombres callen en la iglesia» is her adaptation of 14:28, not scripture, and is not listed.
Galatians 3:28 is also paraphrased without quotation marks in chapter 8 (block 4) in the same mined wording.
